title: Inmuebles24 Scraper
description: Collect property listings from Inmuebles24. Paste a search URL, or enter a location and filters to build the search.

startUrl.title: Search URL
startUrl.description: Any Inmuebles24 search results URL, including its filters and page number. Used when Location is empty. Example: https://www.inmuebles24.com/departamentos-en-venta-en-polanco.html

location.title: Location
location.description: City, neighborhood, or state, for example Polanco, Guadalajara, or Jalisco. When filled, this overrides the URL and the filters below define the search.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: Sale, rent, transfer, or temporary/vacation. Used with Location.

propertyType.title: Property type
propertyType.description: Property type for the Location search.

minPrice.title: Minimum price (MXN)
minPrice.description: Lowest listing price in Mexican pesos. Used with Location.

maxPrice.title: Maximum price (MXN)
maxPrice.description: Highest listing price in Mexican pesos. Used with Location.

bedroomsMin.title: Minimum bedrooms
bedroomsMin.description: Smallest number of bedrooms. Used with Location.

bathroomsMin.title: Minimum bathrooms
bathroomsMin.description: Smallest number of bathrooms. Used with Location.

parkingMin.title: Minimum parking spaces
parkingMin.description: Smallest number of parking spaces. Used with Location.

publishedWithinDays.title: Published within (days)
publishedWithinDays.description: Only listings published in the last N days. Used with Location.

results_wanted.title: Maximum results
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of listings to save.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Safety cap on search pages. Each page holds up to 30 listings.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxy access is recommended. The Actor uses a stealth browser to clear the site check, then reads the listing API directly.
